# KM-172 — Browser channel-event decode and pill

**Lane:** events · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-170, KM-120 · **Serializes with:** KM-130, KM-134, KM-135 (`matrix-browser.ts`), KM-182 (shared thread styles)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · [events plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-003-feat-channel-events-plan.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/features/timeline/ChannelEventPill.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/timeline/ChannelEventPill.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/timeline/channel-event-pill.css`. Shared (small, listed edits only): `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts`, `packages/messaging/src/channels/substrate.ts`, `packages/messaging/src/channels/timeline.ts`, `apps/web/src/features/timeline/controller.ts`, `apps/web/src/features/timeline/TimelineScreen.tsx`.

## Outcome

A decrypted `com.khala.event.v1` timeline event renders in the thread as a compact centered pill: status dot, `formatChannelEventLine(content)`, ` · `, and the time. It links to `url` in a new tab when present. Malformed events render nothing. Events never appear in the conversation-list preview and never count as new messages.

## Context and evidence

- Events plan unit **E-U3** (R3–R5, R7, R8; AE1, AE4–AE6), KTD1, KTD3.
- **Today's decode drops every non-message type**: `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:385` (`if (event.getType() !== EventType.RoomMessage) return null;`) inside `projectMatrixTimelineEvent` (`matrix-browser.ts:367`). That is why R11/AE6 already hold.
- **The plan's single-file change is not enough.** The projected event type is the `SubstrateEvent` union in `packages/messaging/src/channels/substrate.ts:45-63`; it flows through `toEntry` (`packages/messaging/src/channels/timeline.ts:46-71`) into `TimelineEntry` (`timeline.ts:18-27`), out through `observeEntries` (`packages/messaging/src/channels/index.ts:40`), into the web `TimelineRow` (`apps/web/src/features/timeline/controller.ts:15-16`) and finally `TimelineScreen.tsx:331-343`. Each layer needs one new variant. Follow the existing `unavailable` placeholder precedent: contract pages (`TimelinePage`) never carry it; only the entries view does (`timeline.ts:95-96` comment: "The contract page has no placeholder shape; `observeEntries` carries them.").
- The events plan's file `apps/web/src/features/timeline/ChannelEventPill.tsx` is kept. Its plan path note "provisional to the M1 layout" resolves to `apps/web/src/features/timeline/` (exists at `5db209cc`).
- Conversation preview reads only `m.room.message` (`matrix-browser.ts:138-140`); no change needed there.
- Styling ownership: KM-182 (design lane) owns "thread, bubbles, day separators, event pill style" and `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/*`. This ticket ships functional, scoped CSS in its own file and must not restyle shared components.

## Scope

- One new `SubstrateEvent`/`TimelineEntry`/`TimelineRow` variant `channel_event`.
- Decode branch in `projectMatrixTimelineEvent`.
- `ChannelEventPill` component, its CSS file and test; render it in `TimelineScreen`.

## Non-goals

- Restyling `ChatThread`, `ChatMessage`, `ChatSystemEvent`, `conversation.css`, `tokens.css` or the design's `.kh-ev` look: **KM-182** (and KM-180 for tokens).
- Agent attribution badges on messages: **KM-135**.
- Sending events: **KM-173**. Agent reading: **KM-174**.
- Events in the conversation preview, update-in-place, filters, grouping runs of events: deferred (events plan Scope Boundaries).

## Contract and invariants

contracts.md C9, verbatim: "Defined by `docs/plans/2026-10-01-003-feat-channel-events-plan.md`, with Matrix type `com.khala.event.v1`. Its contract file is `packages/contracts/src/m1/channel-event.ts`."

New variant, identical at every layer (substrate, entry, row):

```ts
Readonly<{ kind: 'channel_event'; eventId: EventId; participant: ParticipantView; content: ChannelEventContent; receivedAt: string }>
```

Invariants: text renders only as React text nodes (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no markdown); order is timeline order, never `occurred_at` (R7); the first event per `key` wins (R8); a decode failure produces no row (R4).

## Implementation pointers (refreshable @ `5db209cc`)

### Files

- Create: `apps/web/src/features/timeline/ChannelEventPill.tsx`, `ChannelEventPill.test.tsx`, `channel-event-pill.css`.
- Modify: the five shared files above, plus their existing adjacent tests only where typecheck forces it.

### Worked example

Matrix event: type `com.khala.event.v1`, sender `@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local` (display `Claude · Kevin`), `origin_server_ts` 2026-10-01T10:09:30Z, content = the KM-171 AE1 output (`summary: "review requested"`, `subject.ticket: "AIUR-395"`, `subject.branch: "feat/events-cursor"`, `status: "pending"`, `url: "https://github.com/aiur-team/aiur/pull/412"`, `occurred_at: "2026-10-01T10:09:00.000Z"`).

Rendered markup:

```html
<li data-event-id="$ev1" class="channel-event-pill">
  <a class="channel-event-pill__link" href="https://github.com/aiur-team/aiur/pull/412" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="From Claude · Kevin">
    <i class="channel-event-pill__dot channel-event-pill__dot--pending" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    <span class="channel-event-pill__text" dir="auto">AIUR-395 review requested · feat/events-cursor</span>
    <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span><time dateTime="2026-10-01T10:09:00.000Z">10:09</time>
  </a>
</li>
```

Without `url`, `<a …>` becomes `<div class="channel-event-pill__link" title="…">`.

### Steps

1. `substrate.ts`: add the `channel_event` variant to `SubstrateEvent`. Import `ChannelEventContent` as a type from `@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event`.
2. `matrix-browser.ts` `projectMatrixTimelineEvent`: immediately before the `EventType.RoomMessage` check, add: if `event.getType() === CHANNEL_EVENT_TYPE`, run `decodeChannelEvent(event.getContent())`; return `null` when not ok; otherwise return `{ kind: 'channel_event', eventId, participant, content: decoded.value, receivedAt }`. Do not require `authorDeviceId`.
3. `timeline.ts`: add the variant to `TimelineEntry`; in `toEntry` return it unchanged (no digest) for `kind === 'channel_event'`; make `eventIdOf` return `entry.eventId` for it. `timeline()` already keeps only `message` items in contract pages; leave that. `supersedes` needs no change.
4. `controller.ts`: add the variant to `TimelineRow`; `rowId` returns `row.eventId` for it; in the observer loop skip it in the `unavailableNameEvents` update; exclude it from the `newMessageCount` increment (events are not messages). `recent` stays message-only.
5. `ChannelEventPill.tsx`: `export function ChannelEventPill({ id, content, senderName, receivedAt })`. Compute `status = statusFor(content)`, `line = formatChannelEventLine(content)`, `time = content.occurred_at ?? receivedAt`, label `new Date(time).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: 'UTC' })`. Render exactly the worked-example markup. Import `./channel-event-pill.css`.
6. `channel-event-pill.css`: classes prefixed `channel-event-pill` only. Centered (`align-self: center; list-style: none`), inline-flex, small muted text, `border-radius: 999px`, 1px `var(--khala-line)` border, 7px round dot. Dot colours: `--success` → `--khala-status-positive`; `--failure` → `--khala-status-critical`; `--attention` → `--khala-status-caution`; `--pending` → `--khala-accent`; `--info` → `--khala-ink-muted`. Add the top-of-file comment `/* Functional baseline. Visual design owned by KM-182. */`.
7. `TimelineScreen.tsx`: wrap `rows` (line 136 memo) with `dedupeByKey(rows, row => row.kind === 'channel_event' ? row.content.key : undefined)`. In the render loop, before the `unavailable` branch, render `<ChannelEventPill key={row.eventId} id={row.eventId} content={row.content} senderName={row.participant.displayName} receivedAt={row.receivedAt} />` for `channel_event`. The existing `grouped={previous?.kind === 'message' && …}` stays: a pill between two messages breaks the group, a dropped event does not.
8. Fix any exhaustive-switch or narrowing errors `pnpm typecheck` reports in the touched packages by handling `channel_event` as "not a message". Do not change behaviour for other kinds.

## Test scenarios

- `apps/web/src/features/timeline/ChannelEventPill.test.tsx` (`renderToStaticMarkup`):
  1. AE1 content → contains `AIUR-395 review requested · feat/events-cursor`, `10:09`, `href="https://github.com/aiur-team/aiur/pull/412"`, `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. (Covers AE1)
  2. Each status → the matching `channel-event-pill__dot--<status>` class.
  3. AE4: `{kind:'deploy.finished', summary:'staging deployed'}` → dot `--info`, text `staging deployed`, a `<div>` with no `href`. (Covers AE4, R3)
  4. Summary `<b>x</b> **y**` → escaped as `&lt;b&gt;x&lt;/b&gt; **y**`; no `<b>` element. (Covers AE5, R5)
  5. No `occurred_at` → time comes from `receivedAt`.
- `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.test.ts` (extend):
  6. A `com.khala.event.v1` event with valid content → `kind: 'channel_event'`.
  7. Same type with `url: 'javascript:alert(1)'` → `null`. (Covers AE5, R4)
  8. `m.room.message` behaviour unchanged (existing tests stay green). (Covers AE6, R11)
- `packages/messaging/src/channels/timeline.test.ts` (extend):
  9. `toEntry` passes a `channel_event` through; `timeline()` page `items` exclude it.
- `apps/web/src/features/timeline/TimelineScreen.test.tsx` (extend):
  10. Rows `[msg A(alice), event(key k), event(key k), msg B(alice)]` → exactly one pill; message B is not `conversation-message--grouped`. (Covers R8, AE2)
  11. A row list where the event was dropped at decode (`[msg A, msg B]`, same author) → B is grouped.
  12. `newMessageCount` does not increase when only a `channel_event` row arrives while scrolled up (controller test in `controller.test.ts`).

## Verification

```
pnpm --filter @khala/contracts test -- channel-event
pnpm --filter @khala/messaging test -- timeline
pnpm --filter @khala/web test -- ChannelEventPill TimelineScreen matrix-browser controller
pnpm typecheck
```

Done when the tests pass and, on the local stack (`pnpm stack:up`, KM-101), a `com.khala.event.v1` event sent into a channel (KM-173's `khala_event`, or a dev-console `client.sendEvent(roomId, 'com.khala.event.v1', content)`) shows one pill in both browsers. Attach a screenshot to the PR. Root typecheck failures outside the touched packages are recorded, not fixed (KTD11).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Serialization.** KM-182 restyles the thread; KM-130, KM-134 and KM-135 edit `matrix-browser.ts` (KM-135 also timeline attribution). Rebase on whichever merged first; if a conflict touches behaviour (not just lines), stop and ask.
- If a reviewer or KM-182 asks this ticket to change `ConversationLayout.tsx`, `conversation.css` or `tokens.css`: refuse; that is KM-182's surface.
- If KM-120 has replaced `features/timeline` or the `SubstrateEvent` pipeline with something else, re-point the same four-layer change to the new types; if there is no entries view at all, stop and ask.
- If `@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event` does not resolve from `apps/web` or `packages/messaging`, stop (KM-104/KM-170 not landed).

## Complexity rationale

3 (roster v2): the plan names one decode line, but the event must pass through four typed layers in two packages, plus a new component. Each edit is small and the precedent (`unavailable` rows) exists.
